name: Rivery
description_en:
Rivery is a product in the Data integration category. Its directory profile covers Managed File Transfers, Data Transformation, Data Filtering, Data Extraction, Match & Merge, Master Data Management, Metadata Management, Data Integration.

Additional listed capabilities include Data Analysis, Version Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: convert data into a required format or structure; combine information from connected sources; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出数据分析、版本控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。
